screening_policy: Retain unique original source implementations or substantive academic/engineering/forum evidence. Exclude search false-positives, meta-lists and visualization-only projects. Repository-discovered projects without code-line examination are classified as catalog coverage, not deep implementation verification.
confidence_scope: Top-tier design conclusions rely on original project docs/source, W3C semantics, and uploaded reference PDFs; repository catalogue annotations are high-level and not full audits.
